schema: CREATE TABLE Customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, address TEXT, phone TEXT, email TEXT); CREATE TABLE Accounts (account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, account_type TEXT, balance DECIMAL, open_date DATE, FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES Customers(customer_id)); CREATE TABLE Transactions (transaction_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER, transaction_type TEXT, amount DECIMAL, transaction_date DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES Accounts(account_id)); CREATE TABLE Branches (branch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, branch_name TEXT, location TEXT, total_assets DECIMAL);
correct_query: SELECT customer_id, SUM(balance) FROM Accounts GROUP BY customer_id;
